title: Verifier Claim Registry - v7
description: Managed MCP Action Mapping evidence claims. These claims report what a signed Permit binds about a human-approved mapping, its governance interpretation, and its activation reference. They never convert a bound reference into a verified ceremony, an eligibility into a dispatch, or an arbitrary mapping into a certified action contract.

claims.name: permit.mcp_action_mapping_binding.v1
claims.assertion: The signed managed-MCP Permit binds one exact source identity, the mapping ID, the mapping revision, the canonical manifest hash, the mapping lifecycle epoch, the mapping assurance, the target governance-action ID, version and catalog-entry hash, the versioned challenge basis, and the activation-record reference that Keel's decision used.
claims.required_evidence: A supported signed Permit decision whose signed resource attributes carry one schema-valid keel.mcp_action_mapping_evidence.v1 block with enforcement_surface_key=managed_mcp:action_mapping and permit_action_name=mcp.tool.call; individually present mapping revision and challenge_basis_version; a complete governance-action identity; a typed certified-action-contract state consistent with the mapping assurance; and an activation record reference bound to the mapping's activated lifecycle epoch.
does_not_establish: dispatch
provider acceptance or completion
downstream effect
independent verification of the WebAuthn activation assertion
that the approving human understood the mapping or the handler semantics
handler semantics, certified action facts, or the deployed source revision
absence of execution outside the governed boundary
that any certified action contract was bound
that human approval preceded upstream dispatch

claims.name: permit.mcp_governance_interpretation.v1
claims.assertion: Keel evaluated this exact managed MCP request under the named human-approved governance interpretation and the mandatory review floor, and the signed execution evidence binds the reviewed-approval consumption record, the distinct reviewed and execution Permits, both decision traces, the exact-review, approval-requirement, exact-request and idempotency binding values, and the consumption instant.
claims.required_evidence: A supported permit.mcp_action_mapping_binding.v1 on an execution artifact whose signed mapping evidence carries challenge_class=action_review and a complete approval group whose execution Permit is the Permit under adjudication, whose reviewed Permit is a distinct record, and whose dispatch-claim state is typed rather than inferred.
does_not_establish: dispatch
provider acceptance or completion
downstream effect
which approvals satisfied the frozen approval requirement
that two humans approved
that Keel required human approval before upstream dispatch
certified action facts, automatic-authorization eligibility, or a certified adapter contract
that the source revision named by the mapping is the deployed one

claims.name: permit.mcp_structural_hold_evidence.v1
claims.assertion: The signed non-approvable structural decision evidence binds the structural challenge class, the versioned challenge basis, the typed absence commitment, and the derivation-diagnostic commitment for a managed MCP request that created no approval action, no execution Permit, and no dispatch claim.
claims.required_evidence: A supported permit.mcp_action_mapping_binding.v1 on a structural artifact whose signed mapping evidence carries challenge_class=structural_hold, non-null typed-absence and derivation-diagnostic hashes, no approval group, and a Permit decision state that is not an allow, together with an absence of dispatch, bounded-use, and provider-receipt evidence in the pack.
does_not_establish: resume or dispatch semantics of any kind
that the unavailable consequence-critical facts are false rather than unestablished
a payment, refund, amount, or business-effect interpretation of the held request
dispatch
provider acceptance or completion
downstream effect
that any certified action contract was bound
